name: The AI Automation Agent Database
description: An AI automation agent waits for a trigger, then runs its actions on a rule: file the email, send the reply, write the log. The demo on this page is a LOCAL DEMO ONLY: it is a simulation, follows 4 written rules, makes 0 real automation calls, and hosted automation is BLOCKED. A real automation agent needs a hosted backend, and this page honestly says so. Nothing is sent anywhere.
